name: ESL analog crossbar cell + KCL summation node
author: cp-4856 PoC graft (grounded in analog-ai EmbML-HB-2026-Ch-AnalogEDAI/fig/figstyle.tex, not a fork of that file)
description: Analog in-memory-compute crossbar readout: 2x2 weight-cell array driven by row voltage sources, per-column KCL summation (Sigma) nodes, and a real circuitikz device-symbol readout stage (sense resistor / reference current source) per column. First circuitikz-based template in this local checkout -- opentikz ships zero circuitikz coverage upstream. Colors are the ESL domain-semantic tokens (contract §2, ADR-0005 D7): inputdomain=input/activation (blue), weightdomain=analog weight cell (green), analogdomain=analog current/summation (orange) -- extending opentikz's five-color ot* palette, not remapped onto it (see reference/color-palettes/color-palettes.md and cp-4856 learnings note on the palette-invariant collision).

edit_contract.node_naming: v-source: (vin-1, vin-2); crossbar-cell: (cell-1-1, cell-2-1, cell-1-2, cell-2-2); kcl-node: (kcl-1, kcl-2)

operations.summary: edit the matching label macro, or the literal $G_{i,j}$/$I_{i,j}$ text in a cell/current-label node (kept literal, not macro-driven, to preserve the family's comma-separated two-index subscript convention -- see invariants)

add \node[vsource] (vin-3) at (0,-2*\rowgap) {...}; add a \node[cell] (cell-3-<c>) per existing column at the same x as cell-1-<c>/cell-2-<c>, y=-2*\rowgap; wire \draw[vwire] (vin-3) -- (cell-3-<c>); and \draw[awire] (cell-3-<c>) -- (kcl-<c>); for every column -- node identifiers stay dash-separated vin-<row>/cell-<row>-<col>/kcl-<col> (cp-4883 family-wide naming ruling, C8), never concatenated-digit

add a \node[cell] (cell-<r>-3) per existing row at x=3*\colgap; wire \draw[vwire] (vin-<r>) -- (cell-<r>-3); add a \node[kclnode] (kcl-3) below the new column; wire every \draw[awire] (cell-<r>-3) -- (kcl-3); and its readout branch (see add-readout-device) -- node identifiers stay dash-separated cell-<row>-<col>/kcl-<col> (cp-4883 family-wide naming ruling, C8), never concatenated-digit

declare \coordinate (dev-<c>) at ($(kcl-<c>)+(0,-1.8)$); then \draw (kcl-<c>) to[<device>, l=$<label>$, o-o] (dev-<c>); -- <device> is a real circuitikz bipole key (R, I, C, L, ...), NOT a figstyle node style; this is the one place this template mixes circuitikz bipoles with hand-styled tikzset nodes. -1.8 is the minimum offset verified collision-free by rendering to PNG (WP-5 fix for the original -1.15, which visually overlapped the KCL node) -- never shrink it back without re-verifying from a render

change the domain-semantic color for a whole role by re-binding that role's palette token (e.g. \colorlet{inputdomain}{...}), never by editing the role's style to a raw color; keep vsource=inputdomain, cell=weightdomain, kclnode/awire/currentlbl=analogdomain, per the analog-ai family's settled scheme, unless a project's own settled-decisions record overrides it (this template ships no settled-decisions record of its own -- it is a PoC graft, not the shipped Phase-1 component library, see D4/R2.3 of ADR-0004)

invariants: a template must not name a semantic component the contract's §1 vocabulary does not define (§1 extensibility rule)
style/color bindings carry their contract §2 token role; a role's color is never swapped for decoration
(seam: no WP-7 family settled-decisions record yet for family 'circuit-schematic'; family-specific placement/style/semantic invariants project here once it lands)
